argv: smoke, not a measurement: ~10 completed originals, 19 succeeded calls, overlap 10; ~45 s

binary_build_provenance.reason: externally supplied binary; attach its actual build log/source identity separately; current checkout hashes do not establish its origin

concurrency.basis: bash $EPOCHREALTIME at command start/end inside each shell; excludes shell fork/exec

cpu.basis: Linux utime+stime at 10 ms ticks; reaped descendants include Bash shells, workload children and dispatched sends, inseparably
cpu.window: before_submit point to active_end point (provider done + 3 s tail)

expectation: smoke, not a measurement: ~10 completed originals, 19 succeeded calls, overlap 10; ~45 s
limits: PSS columns are sequential-scan sums of smaps_rollup over the processes read during each sample's [begin, end] span, not simultaneous snapshots; failed reads are counted per sample and omitted from sums; processes shorter than one interval plus scan are missed; the true peak is unobserved
send processes run under Bash and are counted once, as clients; Bash = shells, their non-rui children and Host forks seen before exec
page cache is system-wide meminfo plus per-file fincore residency; it is not process PSS and is never added to PSS columns
in-shell timestamps use bash $EPOCHREALTIME builtins around each command; they exclude fork/exec of the shell itself
fixture/controller excluded from Rui counters; observer CPU is reported separately and not subtracted

measurement_checkout.platform: Linux e2b.local 6.1.158+ #1 SMP PREEMPT_DYNAMIC Wed Sep 30 12:40:02 UTC 2026 x86_64 GNU/Linux

sample_coverage.basis: identities seen in at least one sample, and those with at least one successful PSS read, versus the minimum the turn creates; seen can exceed expected when shells fork subshells

seed.method: one ordinary `rui session send --text` Message per Session, answered without tools
